title: 藏身大师 Veiled Master
body:
**藏身大师 Veiled Master**

**前提条件：在隐秘和侦查上受训**

Veiled masters are drawn primarily from the ranks of martial artists who have learned to perceive the world around them with little or no light. In keeping with your veiled master training, you prefer to attack from hiding, either striking from existing shadow or wrapping yourself in the gloom you learn to create. The features of the veiled master path reward those of a stealthy disposition, including monks, rogues, rangers, and other lightly armored warriors.

**11级：关闭遮幕 Close the Veil**

Your connection to shadow lets you weave an invisible veil that swallows light sources at your whim.

**增益：**每轮一次以一个次要动作，你可以让一个离你10格内的不大于小型营火的非魔法光源熄灭。使用此方式熄灭的光源不能再被点亮，直到遭遇结束

**11级：蒙眼行动 Blindfold Action**

When you push yourself in combat, the shadow power you channel unfurls as strands of darkness that bind your opponent's eyes.

**增益：**当你花费一个行动点来进行一次近战或近程武器攻击时，该攻击命中的第一个目标同时目盲，直到你下一回合结束

**11级：藏身打击 Veiled Strike**

A dark maelstrom wraps you tight, obscuring all sight for your foes even as it leaves them open to your attacks.

⟦藏身打击 Veiled Strike⟧

**12级：藏身之眼 Veiled Eyes**

The long hours you have spent training in conditions of total darkness have sharpened your senses. When you focus those senses, your foes cannot hope to hide from you.

⟦藏身之眼 Veiled Eyes⟧

**16级：黑暗打击 Dark Strike**

As your ability to fight without reliance on your eyes increases, not even the deepest darkness or the power of invisibility can protect a foe from your wrath.

**增益：**当你攻击一个你不能看见的敌人时，你在攻击骰上受到-2减值，而不是-5

**20级：黑暗漩涡 Maelstrom of Darkness**

You have mastered the ebb and flow of shadow, allowing you to drape an ebon dawn around your enemies. This inky veil of darkness flares at your command, lashing out against all opponents caught within it and leaving a pool of shadow on the battlefield.

⟦黑暗漩涡 Maelstrom of Darkness⟧

title: 沉思炽念使 Contemplative Ardent
body:
**沉思炽念使 Contemplative Ardent**
//

**前提条件：炽念使**

From the time you first felt another's emotion, from the moment you experienced another's thought, you have struggled against the flood that threatens to drown out your identity. It seemed you would never grow comfortable with your strange talent—and yet, against all odds, you did. You developed your concentration to drive back outside influences, but you still can't remember the last time you were alone in your head.

Training, focus, or natural adaptability has let you control the voices invading your thoughts. You can now single them out and use them to warn you of hidden dangers or to find ways around a foe's defenses. In effect, your supernatural senses give you cues to leading and fighting in battle.

**11级：沉思行动 Contemplative Action**

You use the pain and hurt sensed in others to help you push beyond your normal limits.

**增益：**当你花费一个行动点来进行一次攻击时，你在此攻击的攻击骰和伤害骰上获得等同于你心灵感应范围内重伤生物数量的加值

**11级：典范灵能点 Paragon Power Points**

Your ability to draw and use psionic energy grows.

**增益：**你获得2个额外灵能点。

**11级：传心之念 Telepathic Mind**

You can hear and transmit thoughts to other creatures.

**增益：**你获得心灵感应5。如果你已经有心灵感应，则增加其范围5格。在遭遇中你的灵能点第一次降至0时，每个在你心灵感应范围内的盟友在攻击骰上获得+2威能加值，直到你下一回合结束

**11级：收割思绪 Thought Harvest**

Although you can pick up thoughts from sentient creatures, they are usually surface thoughts, random and disjointed. Using psionic energy, you can burrow a hole through an opponent's mental defenses to peer into that creature's thoughts.

⟦收割思绪 Thought Harvest⟧

**12级：唤醒沉睡者 Sleeper Awakens**

You learn how to put yourself into a combat trance. In this state, you filter out distractions so you can read your enemies' minds with terrifying accuracy.

⟦唤醒沉睡者 Sleeper Awakens⟧

**16级：反转之冕 Inverted Corona**

When you use your psionic energy to heal the injured, you draw the pain and hurt into yourself and then quash it with your mind. Other creatures feel this phenomenon and are involuntarily drawn to you.

**增益：**每当你让一个盟友花费一个回复力时，你能以一个自由动作拉近在你心灵感应范围内的一个或两个盟友2格

**20级：精神洪流 Open the Floodgates**

For anyone other than an empath, emotions and thoughts sensed in others are without weight, appearing and fading. For you, though, they linger in your consciousness. When you can carry them no further, you release them in a furious attack against your foes.

⟦精神洪流 Open the Floodgates⟧

title: 晨曦领主 Morninglord
prerequisite: 任意神术职业，必须信仰阿曼纳塔
body:
**晨曦领主 Morninglord**
"Where our god's light shines, there is hope. Where there is no light, we quest."

**前提条件：任意神术职业，必须信仰阿曼纳塔**

In the years following the Spellplague, Lathander, the eternally young god of new beginnings and hope, transfigured into his ancient incarnation Amaunator. Although Amaunator dropped the youthful mask he had worn for centuries, his experiences as the Dawn Lord shook him from his ancient mindset. Amaunator is still a dignified god of immense age, but he remembers his youth, and he encourages his followers to do the same.

As a Morninglord, you are the champion of your god's youth. The optimistic spirit of Lathander guides you as you seek to master the chaos of the new world. The fires of your god burn within you and lend you the inexhaustible energy of youth. You are tireless, fierce, rebellious and full of hope. You shine like a beacon in the darkest hours of night, inspiring those around you to greatness they never dreamed possible.

To your enemies you are the searing sun itself, shedding scorching brilliance from your form. Evil is confronted by fiery annihilation in your wake, for though you walk with Lathander's carefree spirit, your heart burns with the all-consuming fire of Amaunator.

**11级：激进曙光 Militant Dawn**

**增益：**当你使用任何引导神力威能时，你可同时选择离你5格内的一个敌人，它受到等同于你魅力调整值的光耀伤害。

**11级：不懈活力 Unflagging Energy**

**增益：**当你花费一个行动点进行额外动作用来攻击时，此攻击的重击范围变为18~20。

**11级：纯净微光 Pure Glow**

⟦纯净微光 Pure Glow⟧

**12级：旭日 Rising Sun**

⟦旭日 Rising Sun⟧

**16级：灼烧之光 Burning Radiance**

**增益：**当你以带有光耀关键字的威能命中时，目标获得10点光耀易伤直到你下回合结束。

**20级：黎明之矛 Lance of Dawn**

⟦黎明之矛 Lance of Dawn⟧

title: 承怒者 Wrathbearer
prerequisite: 战士，「狂怒活力」职业特性
body:
**承怒者 Wrathbearer**
「来啊，打我啊。给你脸了。」

**前提条件：战士，「狂怒活力」职业特性**

You were a terrible student. Wild and unpredictable, no lesson stuck with you. No matter how hard you tried, you'd revert back to your old reckless ways. Your problem might have come from a life among savage and warlike people, or you could just havea nasty temper. In either case, your time at the war college was brief when it was clear the instructors had nothing to teach you. In your adventures since, you have learned to channel your wrath into your attacks. When you look back on the stodgy lessons and unbearable drills, you laugh because you have learned a better way to kill.

**11级：驾驭狂怒 Mounting Rage**

**增益：**当你以鼓舞攻击威能失手时，你在你的下一个攻击骰上获得+2加值。

**11级：凶蛮行动 Savage Action**

**增益：**当你花费一个行动点进行额外动作时，你在武器攻击的攻击骰上获得+1加值，并在武器攻击的伤害骰上加上1[W]额外伤害，直到你下一回合结束。

**11级：怒意爆发 Explosive Outburst**

⟦怒意爆发 Explosive Outburst⟧

**12级：嘲弄目标 Mocking Target**

⟦嘲弄目标 Mocking Target⟧

**16级：无边坚韧 Endless Endurance**

**增益：**你的最大生命值增加等同于两倍你体质调整值的数值。

**20级：无匹伟力 Unequaled Might**

⟦无匹伟力 Unequaled Might⟧

title: 赤衣狂徒 Red Cloak
prerequisite: 游荡者，⟦赤衣学徒 <流派初成> Red Cloak Student <Lesser Style>⟧专长
body:
**赤衣狂徒 Red Cloak**
「除非你准备好了，否则不要上房顶。」

**前提条件：游荡者，⟦赤衣学徒 <流派初成> Red Cloak Student <Lesser Style>⟧专长**

You're a red cloak, a roof-running scoundrel who tests your wits against other denizens of the night. Your colors reflect your passion and signal danger to anyone who isn't prepared to fight you.

You might or might not be versed in the history of your art. In the past, the Red Cloaks were a guild of assassins known for their flamboyance. The true secrets of their activities remain a mystery, but their style—both in fighting and in dress—spread to dandy and street fighter alike.
You might have grown up in the streets, idolizing the swaggering red cloak warariors who ran the rooftops at night. You could be the youngest child of a noble seeking excitement by trying your hand in seedy environs. Instead, you might be a remnant of the original Red Cloaks. Regardless of your motivation, you scoff at those who don the cloak without the attitude or the skill. Any who fight you know that you are no common thug or flouncing dandy.

In your adventures, you seek to test your street-honed mettle against the warriors of other domains. You don't necessarily seek to emulate their style, but you respect it and wish to learn from it. You take every opportunity to challenge the street-runners of other cities, and you will gladly face any enemy that thinks to challenge you.

**11级：绯红暴行 Crimson Brutality**

**增益：**当你花费一个行动点进行一次造成偷袭伤害的攻击，此偷袭伤害取最大值。

**11级：屋顶奔者 Roof Runner**

**增益：**当一个敌人以攻击对你失手，你能以一个即时反应快步2格。

**11级：赤衣之舞 Dance of the Cloak**

⟦赤衣之舞 Dance of the Cloak⟧

**12级：赤红之式 Scarlet Maneuver**

⟦赤红之式 Scarlet Maneuver⟧

**16级：赤衣回击 Red Cloak Reaction**

**增益：**当你以即时动作进行的攻击对所有目标失手，此动作不计入你一轮一个即时动作的限制。

**20级：赤红还击 Crimson Rebuttal**

⟦赤红还击 Crimson Rebuttal⟧

title: 炽白之冠 Incandescent Champion
body:
**炽白之冠 Incandescent Champion**
「Not even the gods can control the perfect beauty and boundless power contained in the mortal soul.」

**前提条件：任意灵能职业**

Mortals might be flawed creations, given to error and misjudgment. But all mortals are blessed with a singular gift: the soul. Psionic energy revealed your soul's power, and through long study and introspection, you learned to navigate the labyrinthine pathways of your being.

This energy suffuses you and surrounds you in a radiant glow. Although you can dampen your inner light, you and others around you find its presence comforting. In time, the light responds to your commands, burning your enemies while bolstering your allies, or even allowing your soul to eclipse your body.

The more you access your soul's power, the more you understand that this essence must be guarded. Those who would exploit souls, twisting them for dark ends, and those who would hoard souls on their journey beyond the body must be destroyed and their prisoners freed. To this end, you commit yourself against the myriad villains who use or abuse souls.

**11级：耀眼过载 Brilliant Overload**

**增益：**每当你以一个强化灵能随意攻击威能命中一个敌人时，你可以花费1个灵能点来让此威能造成1d6额外光耀伤害。

**11级：启明行动 Luminous Action**

**增益：**当你花费一个行动点来进行额外动作时，你在10格内散发明亮光照直到你下一回合结束。当你散发这种光照时，邻近你的敌人获得等同于你体质调整值的光耀易伤。

**11级：典范灵能点 Paragon Power Points**

**增益：**你获得2个额外灵能点。

**11级：炽白击 Incandescent Strike**

⟦炽白击 Incandescent Strike⟧

**12级：难耐尊容 Unbearable Countenance**

⟦难耐尊容 Unbearable Countenance⟧

**16级：炽白姿态 Incandescent Presence**

**增益：**你在3格内散发明亮光照。以一个自由动作，你可以将此光照减少为昏暗光照或完全消除它。你能以一个自由动作重启此光照。

当你因此典范特性散发明亮光照并造成重击时，每个在光照内的盟友获得等同于你体质调整值的临时生命值，并且每个在光照内的敌人受到等同于你体质调整值的光耀伤害。

**20级：完美炽白 Perfect Incandescence**

⟦完美炽白 Perfect Incandescence⟧

title: 冲锋猛兽 Rampaging Brute
prerequisite: 战士，⟦食人魔蛮力学徒 <流派初成> Ogremight Student <Lesser Style>⟧专长
body:
**冲锋猛兽 Rampaging Brute**
「My hammer says that it and me are coming in fast and getting what we came for.」

**前提条件：战士，⟦食人魔蛮力学徒 <流派初成> Ogremight Student <Lesser Style>⟧专长**

Your arrival is heralded by the crash of splintering wood and the roar of a battle cry. When you smash through a door with a single swing of your massive weapon and barrel into the midst of your enemies, they dodge out of the way—if they're wise. If battle has taught you anything, it's that weight plus momentum equals deadly force. When you set your bulk in motion, anyone smart knows to stay out of your way.

Goliaths are famous for defending mountain passes with a squad of slingers, a pile of boulders, and a rampaging brute who rushes downhill and slams into the leader of the opposing force as a killing rain of rock and stone smashes that foe's allies. Goliath legends tell of the first rampaging brute, Roglarok, who charged into the midst of a company of hobgoblins beneath Tizun's Halls. No one in his tribe could have defeated them single-handedly, but by drawing the defenders off, Roglarok allowed his allies to achieve a victory by sneaking in behind the distracted hobgoblins.

Your tactics as a rampaging brute focus on charging in and tying up foes, keeping them away from the more frail members of your party. Your preferred weapon is a heavy weight at the end of a sturdy haft. You favor light armor or chainmail so that your charges can carry you farther into the heart of the battle. You'll be hit frequently, but your fury will keep you fighting no matter how grievous your wounds become.

**11级：蛮兽冲锋 Brute Charge**

**增益：**每当一个敌人在你冲锋时以借机攻击命中你，你能在此借机攻击结算后以一个自由动作击倒该敌人。

**11级：暴冲者行动 Rampager's Action**

**增益：**当你花费一个行动点来冲锋一个敌人时，作为冲锋一部分的第一次攻击在命中时造成2[W]额外伤害，或在失手时造成等同于你力量调整值的伤害。

**11级：冲撞之兽 Barreling Swing**

⟦冲撞之兽 Barreling Swing⟧

**12级：翻滚践踏 Tumbling Trample**

⟦翻滚践踏 Tumbling Trample⟧

**16级：践踏暴冲者 Trampling Rampager**

**增益：**在冲锋时，你可以移动穿过敌人的格子。

**20级：蛮兽狂怒 Brutal Fury**

⟦蛮兽狂怒 Brutal Fury⟧

title: 初醒远见 Awakened Visionary
body:
**初醒远见 Awakened Visionary**
「未来的路有许多条，但跟上由我带领的那一条，你能寻到你想要的胜利。」

**前提条件：炽念使**

Incursions from the Far Realm have left scars across the world throughout the ages, so that the material fabric of the mortal realm is riddled with holes and fault lines. Your psionic power has made you sensitive to the damage caused by the aberrant invasion, and it has given you a talent for using that damage to your own advantage.

The memories come to you in dreams and waking visions, instructing you in forgotten fighting techniques to better combat the invasion from the Outside. These revelations also grant you a unique perspective on the world, allowing you to seek hidden pathways through time and space. Through these unseen scars of ancient battles, you move from place to place in a flash and can open portals through which you scatter your enemies across the battlefield. The more destruction caused by the threat of the Far Realm, the more powerful you become. Most importantly, this knowledge also tells you that the aberrant menace will one day be defeated.

**11级：次元行动 Dimensional Action**

**增益：**当你花费一个行动点进行一次攻击时，你能在此攻击之前或之后传送等同于你感知调整值的格数

**11级：典范灵能点 Paragon Power Points**

**增益：**你获得2个额外灵能点。

**11级：丧志愿景 Unnerving Vision**

**增益：**每当你以未强化的炽念使随意威能命中一个敌人时，你标记此敌人直到你下一回合结束

**11级：裂口传送门 Yawning Portals**

⟦裂口传送门 Yawning Portals⟧

**12级：清晰视界 Clear Horizon**

⟦清晰视界 Clear Horizon⟧

**16级：瞬息调整 Instant Adjustment**

**增益：**每当一个被你标记的敌人在邻近你的一格结束其回合时，你能以一个自由动作传送此敌人到邻近你的未被占据的另一格

**20级：交错景观 Warping Landscape**

⟦交错景观 Warping Landscape⟧

title: 触媒 Catalyst
body:
**触媒 Catalyst**
「我是解开你潜在力量的钥匙。」

**前提条件：炽念使**

Although knowledge and training are great virtues, sometimes such expertise acts as a barrier. Knowledge can breed complacency, blinding an individual to a better path. As an individual specializes, time spent gaining a deeper understanding of the chosen specialty is time not used to expand his or her knowledge in other areas. Too much focus can narrow the vision.

Rather than bind yourself to one pursuit and one belief, you expand your mind and reject your assumptions. In doing so, you find new possibilities to explore. The lessons you learn help you overcome different challenges and hardships, and they allow you to adapt to whatever situation you face.

The liberation you enjoy can also extend to your companions. Reaching into their minds, you stir their true selves, shaking them free from the expectations that bind them. No doubts or fears hold them back. They are free to strive harder and to push past limitations their expertise places on them. You are their catalyst, and with a mere mental touch, you effect a transformation to help them become what they were meant to be.

**11级：自适应专精 Adaptive Expertise**

**增益：**每次长休息后，选择一个你没有受训的技能。直到你下一次长休息开始，你被视为如同在此技能上受训

**11级：激发行动 Goading Action**

**增益：**当你花费一个行动点进行一次攻击，且你的第一个攻击骰命中时，邻近你的一个盟友能以一个自由动作快步，并且离你5格内的另一个盟友能以一个自由动作进行一次基本攻击

**11级：典范灵能点 Paragon Power Points**

**增益：**你获得2个额外灵能点。

**11级：暴力冲动 Violent Impulse**

⟦暴力冲动 Violent Impulse⟧

**12级：镇定精神 Serene Mind**

⟦镇定精神 Serene Mind⟧

**16级：爆发重击 Erupting Critical**

**增益：**当你使用一个炽念使威能造成重击时，离你5格内的每个盟友在伤害骰上获得+5加值，直到你下一回合开始

**20级：释放潜能 Unleash the Power Within**

⟦释放潜能 Unleash the Power Within⟧

title: 传奇巫师 Legendary Witch
body:
**传奇巫师 Legendary Witch**

**前提条件：法师（巫师）**

Your reputation as a witch runs far and wide. Bards and other storytellers weave colorful tales about your frightening powers, carrying those stories from land to land. Whether the tales portray you as a saint, a villain, or an enigmatic hand of fate, ordinary folk pray to the gods that you do not one day darken their doors.

**11级：月之恩惠 Favor of the Moon**

When the moon enters the right phase, you grow stronger, drawing more deeply on your coven's experience while the moon reaches the peak of its power.

**增益：**你可以看见邻近你的隐形生物，且你免疫目盲

**11级：月亮社行动 Moon Coven Action**

Witches of the different moon covens learn to reach deep into their own reserves to inspire their allies, preserve themselves, or terrify their enemies.

**增益：**你获得一个与你的月亮社相关联的增益

**暗月社 Dark Moon Coven**
Fear is the force that repels your enemies and causes them to think twice about challenging you. You wield fear as you would a beast on a chain, releasing it when you want to scatter your foes.

**增益：**当你花费一个行动点进行额外动作时，你推离每个邻近你的敌人最多等同于你感知调整值的格数

**满月社 Full Moon Coven**
Even in the darkest night, the light of the full moon illuminates the shadowed world.

**增益：**当你花费一个行动点进行额外动作时，任何离你3格内的敌人提供战斗优势，直到你下一回合结束

**11级：月亮社遭遇威能 Moon Coven Encounter Power**

You have become a master at cursing your foes with the fate they deserve.

**增益：**你获得一个与你的月亮社相关联的遭遇攻击威能，满月社为⟦满月之疯狂 Madness of the Full Moon⟧，暗月社为⟦暗月之恐惧 Terror of the Dark Moon⟧

**满月之疯狂 Madness of the Full Moon**

The full moon is said to make lunatics of lovers and madmen. You know how to channel the moon's tidal pull and cast its radiance among your foes to send them into confusion.

⟦满月之疯狂 Madness of the Full Moon⟧

**暗月之恐惧 Terror of the Dark Moon**

The night holds few terrors for you now. The same cannot be said of your enemies, who cannot fathom the doom that awaits them. With but a gesture, you can take away the light or conjure a deeper darkness in which even creatures born to shadow will find their fears revealed.

⟦暗月之恐惧 Terror of the Dark Moon⟧

**12级：月亮社辅助威能 Moon Coven Utility Power**

Your mastery of witchcraft allows you to cast spells of even greater power.

**增益：**你获得一个与你的月亮社相关联的辅助威能，暗月社为⟦暗月之清算 Dark Moon's Reckoning⟧，满月社为⟦月光恶作剧 Moonlight's Mischief⟧

**暗月之清算 Dark Moon's Reckoning**

Beneath the new moon, the tides rise in the springtime, when life begins anew. Drawing on this power, you can renew your fortune by turning the tides of fate in your favor and casting your enemies' hurts back upon them.

⟦暗月之清算 Dark Moon's Reckoning⟧

**月光恶作剧 Moonlight's Mischief**

The moon is known to play tricks on the eye, bending light and casting phantom shadows that make places appear different from what they had seemed. Your control of the full moon's silvery illumination gives you the power to transform the environment, moving your allies into optimal positions.

⟦月光恶作剧 Moonlight's Mischief⟧

**16级：骑乘夜风 Ride the Night Wind**

The most talented witches learn to cherish the night's embrace, for when they are beneath the moon, witches stand at the apex of their power. You have become able to tame the wild night winds. Whenever you call, they answer, enabling you to ride aloft in your true shape.

⟦骑乘夜风 Ride the Night Wind⟧

**20级：月亮社每日威能 Moon Coven Daily Power**

In the way that moonlight and shadow change how forms are perceived, you can now take the shape of a creature of legend.

**增益：**你获得一个与你的月亮社相关联的每日攻击威能，暗月社为⟦梦魇形态 Nightmare Form⟧，满月社为⟦独角兽形态 Unicorn Form⟧

**梦魇形态 Nightmare Form**

You have learned to transform into a dreaded creature that appears as a flaming horse. In this form, you can gallop around the battlefield, using your hooves to set foes aflame.

⟦梦魇形态 Nightmare Form⟧

**独角兽形态 Unicorn Form**

The full moon sheds light by which the lost can find their way. When you change into a unicorn, your serene form inspires your allies to hold their ground.

⟦独角兽形态 Unicorn Form⟧

title: 传说魔剑士 Legendary Hexblade
body:
**传说魔剑士 Legendary Hexblade**

**前提条件：邪术师（魔剑士）**

You focus your study and arcane practice on your pact, uncovering its mysteries and mastering the magic it offers.

**11级：魔剑士行动 Hexblade's Action**

When you push yourself beyond your normal limits, the magic inherent to your pact flares around you, aiding your efforts.

**增益：**你获得1个与你的契约相关联的典范特性

**11级：契约面貌 Pact Aspect**

As you gain greater skill with arcane magic, you also form a stronger link to your pact. This link alters your mind and body, subtly aligning you with the enigmatic entity granting you your hexblade powers.

**增益：**你获得1个与你的契约相关联的典范特性

**11级：契约诅咒 Pact Curse**

Your pact requires you to seek out, battle, and defeat your enemies. Otherwise, the magic that sustains it slowly fades. As your pact hungers for life force, you learn to turn its needs into a useful weapon. You master a spell that allows you to place a curse upon an enemy.

**增益：**你获得1个与你的契约相关联的典范威能

**12级：契约祈祷 Pact Invocation**

During times of stress or great peril, you can call upon the entity that you forged your pact with to aid you. However, this added demand comes at a price. If you forced a pact upon an unwilling creature, it will aid you only when you have enough strength to demand it. Otherwise, your patron might choose to rob you of the power offered by this spell at an inopportune time due to capriciousness or boredom.

**增益：**你获得1个与你的契约相关联的典范威能

**16级：进阶契约之赐 Improved Pact Boon**

Your continuing dedication to your pact, along with your improved understanding of the underlying mechanics of arcane power, allows you to tap deeper into the source of your magic.

**增益：**你获得1个与你的契约相关联的典范特性

**20级：契约变形 Pact Transformation**

With this powerful spell, you draw fully on your pact's magic and undergo a startling transformation. For a brief time, you take on the aspect of your pact, appearing as a lesser version of an entity from the appropriate realm.

**增益：**你获得1个与你的契约相关联的典范威能

title: 传说杀手 Mythic Slayer
body:
**传说杀手 Mythic Slayer**

**前提条件：战士（杀手）**

You have hacked and slashed your way through numerous foes and endless challenges to reach a state of near-perfect battle prowess. Your weapon has become an almost living extension of your hands and arms, and you can make it perform in ways few other warriors can imagine. The time has come to carve a new legend from the corpses of your fallen enemies.

**11级：传说进攻 Mythic Assault**

You become a whirlwind of devastation in battle, gaining destructive energy with each enemy that falls before you.

**增益：**当你使用近战武器攻击将一个敌人的生命值降至0时，在遭遇结束前你在下一次近战武器伤害骰上获得等同于你敏捷调整值的加值。

**11级：传说杀手行动 Mythic Slayer's Action**

The many battles that you have survived have trained you to focus your concentration so that you can reduce the chaos of combat to a clarifying calm. Opponents' movements seem to slow to a crawl, and your own attacks appear as a blur of steel.

**增益：**当你花费一个行动点进行额外动作时，在此额外动作之前或之后，你能以一个自由动作做一次近战基本攻击

**11级：进阶强力打击 Improved Power Strike**

You can make an additional devastating attack during any battle.

**增益：**你每场遭遇可再多使用一次⟦强力打击 Power Strike⟧威能，但你仍然每回合只能使用一次

**12级：高级武器专精 Greater Weapon Specialization**

You have refined your fi ghting style, hitting hard and striking often.

**增益：**你选择获得下列遭遇威能中的1个

**收割之斧 Reaping Axe**

When you first took up the axe, you treated each missed strike in combat as a failure. In the time since, you have learned to shift your stroke when you feel an attack go wide, forcing your foe to feel a small portion of your deadly strength.

⟦收割之斧 Reaping Axe⟧

**蛇行之刃 Serpentine Blade**

Your intimate understanding of the balance of your blade lets you slash back even after a foe has dodged out of the way of your attack. By catching your enemy off guard, you and your allies gain the upper hand.

⟦蛇行之刃 Serpentine Blade⟧

**震惊之杖 Staggering Staff**

one of the most dangerous things about the staff in your hands is that you can attack with it in a series of quick but varied strikes. Even when you miss your enemies, your quick jabs cause them to flinch away and stumble into whatever position you choose.

⟦震惊之杖 Staggering Staff⟧

**16级：无畏杀手 Fearless Slayer**

The field of battle holds no threat that you cannot stand against. Let the enemy come! You are not afraid.

**增益：**当你重伤时，你在伤害骰上获得+3加值

**20级：凶残专注 Brutal Focus**

You unleash even greater fury when you deliver your signature attack.

**增益：**当你使用⟦强力打击 Power Strike⟧时，你推离目标最多3格，或额外3格如果触发的威能已经推离了目标

title: 春之勇士 Warrior of Spring
prerequisite: 萨满，⟦呼唤精魂伙伴 Call Spirit Companion⟧威能
body:
**春之勇士 Warrior of Spring**
「春天永远会有希望。」

**前提条件：萨满，⟦呼唤精魂伙伴 Call Spirit Companion⟧威能**

The power of spring is in its ability to bring rebirth and hope. A warrior of spring wields this power to great effect, whether as a healer or a guardian of the primal world. As a shaman who follows this path, you are gifted with powers of primal healing beyond those of most other shamans. Your presence can allow allies to recover from the most grievous injury, or even from death itself.

Although you pride yourself in watching over your community, when adventure or the duty of a great cause calls, you are ready to act. You can heal your allies or instill hope in them, and the spirits you call on can help you defeat the greatest of threats.

As you go on adventures, your duty as a warrior of spring is clear. You carry a bundle of seeds gathered from across the lands. No matter what desolate realm you find yourself in, you're ready to scatter those seeds through it so that their verdant bounty can continue the cycle of spring.

**11级：振兴风采 Revitalizing Presence**

**增益：**当你使用一个原力威能让一个盟友花费回复力，此盟友恢复1d6额外生命值。

**11级：春之勇士行动 Warrior of Spring Action**

**增益：**当你花费一个行动点进行额外动作时，离你5格内的一个重伤盟友能花费一个回复力。

**11级：春之曙光 Spring's Dawning**

⟦春之曙光 Spring's Dawning⟧

**12级：超越死亡的希望 Hope Beyond Death**

⟦超越死亡的希望 Hope Beyond Death⟧

**16级：春日活力 Spring's Vigor**

**增益：**当你使用一个原力威能让一个盟友花费回复力，此盟友能同时花费一个行动点进行额外动作。

**20级：春之复苏 Spring's Resurgence**

⟦春之复苏 Spring's Resurgence⟧

title: 慈悲医者 Compassionate Healer
body:
**慈悲医者 Compassionate Healer**
「减缓公正者、无辜者与勇士们的痛苦，是我的最高天职。」

**前提条件：牧师**

剑与魔法只能暂时挡住敌人，只有最好、最勇敢的英雄能击败敌对的力量。而你，则奉献所有心力，只为治疗英雄们的伤痛，支撑他们英勇作战。你是治疗的大师，而且你能慷慨地舍弃自身的力量和生命来援助伙伴。

即使不是你跟随的英雄，你也会冒险舍己救人，这激励了你的伙伴们放手大胆行动。你并没有自我毁灭倾向，你只是坚持自己的理想。你所承受的每道伤口，都能使另一位勇士在你的神祇名号与信仰之下继续奋战。你不怕死亡；你的报偿就在天国。

**11级：慈悲祝福 Compassionate Blessing**

**增益：**当你使用医疗威能让一个盟友花费一个人回复力来恢复生命值时，你能选择受到5点伤害。若你如此做，此威能的目标恢复2d6额外生命值，且你在所有防御上获得+2加值直到你下回合开始。

**11级：无私行动 Selfless Action**

**增益：**当你花费一个行动点进行额外动作时，离你5格内的一位盟友能同时花费一次回复力。

**11级：舍己救人 So Others Might Live**

⟦舍己救人 So Others Might Live⟧

**12级：承受伤害 Bear the Wounds**

⟦承受伤害 Bear the Wounds⟧

**16级：医者奉献 Healer's Sacrifice**

**增益：**当你给予一个盟友机会来花费一次或更多的回复力，且该盟友只有不超过一次的回复力时，你能花费一次或更多的回复力但不恢复生命值。你消耗掉的每次回复力，都会减少该盟友需消耗的回复力次数一次。该盟友恢复生命值如同他花费了这些回复力一般。

**20级：伤者之泪 Martyr's Cry**

⟦伤者之泪 Martyr's Cry⟧

title: 慈悲之子 Son of Mercy
body:
**慈悲之子 Son of Mercy**
「胆敢作恶者，杀无赦。」

**前提条件：防御者职位**

身为秩序、律法与正义的斗士，慈悲之子在印记城的街道上时常可见。但是，越来越多的慈悲之子选择了离开印记城去远行。他们可能选择星海神域立下根基，在妖精沃野或堕影冥界竖起城塞，或者在元素混沌建立对抗法外之徒的前线阵地。他们是秩序的象征，律法的捍卫者，无论身处何处，都坚持正义。慈悲之子可能在任何派系战争中从印记城的屠悯者一系中分列出的群体中被发现，而不仅是指现在印记城中继承该名号的派系。

你指认不法之徒为敌，赐予他们应得的审判，无论是那就地行刑还是抓捕审讯。在同个时刻，你只会将注意力集中在一个目标身上，全身心地追捕亡命者，直至正义得以实行。任何胆敢触犯法律者都将在战场上感受到来自你的恐惧。

**11级：违法者末日 Lawbreaker's Doom**

**增益：**你可以将⟦违法者末日 Lawbreaker's Doom⟧作为遭遇威能使用

⟦违法者末日 Lawbreaker's Doom⟧

**11级：定身行动 Immobilizing Action**

**增益：**当你花费一个行动点对你⟦违法者末日 Lawbreaker's Doom⟧的目标做一次额外攻击时，若该攻击命中，则该目标同时定身直到你下一回合开始

**11级：审判降临 Dispensed Justice**

⟦审判降临 Dispensed Justice⟧

**12级：赤色死亡 Red Death**

⟦赤色死亡 Red Death⟧

**16级：判决之力 Strength of Conviction**

**增益：**当你将你⟦违法者末日 Lawbreaker's Doom⟧的目标生命值降到0时，你获得等同于10 + 你力量调整值的临时生命值

title: 摧城者 Siegebreaker
prerequisite: 战士，「战士武器天赋」职业特性
body:
**摧城者 Siegebreaker**
「这个？介绍一下。这是碎骨者。」

**前提条件：战士，「战士武器天赋」职业特性**

You might have trained at a fighting school or served in a military outfit, but you found all that discipline and all that rigorous training unnecessary. You see no finesse in swinging an axe. You hit someone and they fall. If they don't fall, you're doing it wrong—a problem corrected by just hitting them harder next time. Some warriors sneer at you, dismissing your accomplishments as luck, but the veterans know the truth: You are a killing machine. That's why they call you the siegebreaker. Oh, not because you are good at driving enemies off, but because you are damn good at punching holes through your enemies' defenses and bringing stalemates to sudden, bloody ends.

**11级：裂骨者 Bonerender**

**增益：**每轮一次，当你使用双手武器对一个向你提供战斗优势的敌人进行一次近战攻击时，你的攻击造成等同于你体质调整值的额外伤害。

**11级：凶残行动 Brutal Action**

**增益：**当你使用双手武器进行的近战攻击命中时，你能花费一个行动点来在此伤害骰上获得+1[W]加值。在21级时，此额外伤害增加至+2[W]。

title: 翠林领主 Verdant Lord
body:
**翠林领主 Verdant Lord**
「吾乃森林之一部，森林亦吾之一体。」

**前提条件：守望者**

如林中之树一般，你从沃土、从太阳的光辉，从天空落水与地表流水吸取力量.你接受了树木的精华，成为了森林的保护者对抗那些掠夺者。当你使用你的原力威能时，周围飞速地长出新的植物，花朵绽放，树木坚挺并充满了活力。

你喜欢让你变为树的形态的威能（例如柳条哨兵，橡木哨兵，花楸哨兵），甚至当你处于其他形态时，也能获得大地的回应。在这条道路的顶端，你能获得一个类似树人的形态，用你粗大的枝条握成巨拳击打敌人与和你兵刃相向的目标。

**11级：延伸动作 Reaching Action**

**增益：**当你处于守护者形态下花费一个行动点进行额外动作时，你的近战触及范围增加1格直到你下一回合结束。

**11级：虬曲根须  Writhing Roots**

**增益：**当你处于守护者形态时，邻近你的每一格对敌人来说是困难地形，且每个邻近你的盟友在AC上获得+1加值。

**12级：唤醒森林 Awaken the Forest**

**16级：铁枝 Iron Boughs**

**增益：**当你用近战攻击命中被你标记的敌人时，你在此伤害骰上获得+2加值。

**20级：翠林领主化形 Form of the Verdant Lord**

⟦翠林领主化形 Form of the Verdant Lord⟧

title: 翠绿追踪者 Verdant Stalker
body:
**翠绿追踪者 Verdant Stalker**
「我的脚步轻如飘叶。」

**前提条件：游荡者，在隐秘上受训**

You are a creature of stealth—a warrior who treads so lightly that even the autumn leaves remain silent beneath your step. For you, silence is a way of life and an art.

You're comfortable in the forest, where your abilities to move quietly and to camouflage your movements are at their best. You prefer to wear out your foe, dancing from shadow to shadow and from tree to tree, peppering your enemy with ranged attacks. No enemy has yet caught you standing still.

You might have grown up among forest-dwelling elves or fey. It's also possible that you were once a city dweller who has since become one with nature. You still know of and sometimes visit urban areas, but they have become foreign to you. The forest is your home now, and you're as comfortable in it as a street urchin is in the dock ward of a city. When outsiders invade your territory, you strike back with a furious vengeance, assaulting them with rapid volleys of missiles that kill the intruders or drive them away.

Elves and halflings are most likely to follow this path, but any character who favors stealth and silence, uses ranged attacks with great skill, and is an expert forester can succeed as a verdant stalker.

**11级：精巧射击 Delicate Shot**

**增益：**当你以远程攻击命中一个你对其隐藏的敌人，然后掷「偷袭」伤害骰时，你将1或2视为掷出了3。

**11级：消失行动 Vanishing Action**

**增益：**当你花费一个行动点进行额外动作，你能在此额外动作后进行一次隐秘检定来隐藏。如果你使用此额外动作进行了一个移动动作，则你在此隐秘检定上获得+5加值。

⟦林中幽灵 Forest Specter⟧

title: 大地守卫 Guardian of the Land
body:
**大地守卫 Guardian of the Land**
「谁能比大地本身更能保护它自己呢？」

**前提条件：原力守卫主题**

There is no greater calling than to protect the land, to shelter it from those who would exploit it for the power it contains. Your long associations with the spirit world revealed to you the fragile balance that allows life to continue despite the hardships. Only If this balance is maintained can life and the world recover, and so you make this your work, devoting your life to its protection.

The primal spirits are not blind to your sacrifice, and they respond to your efforts by lending aid where and when they can. Whenever you choose a land to guard, the spirits emerge from the broken landscape to add their strength to your own. They slow enemies as they approach and punish the trespassers

As your bond with the land grows, so too does your understanding of its power. You can draw primal magic into yourself when you assume bestial forms, growing your strength and vitality. Within your guarded sites you can move from place to place, ensuring that nothing under your stewardship comes to harm. And if you face a dire threat, you can call forth the ancient spirits to harry and kill any you name as your enemy.

**11级：护佑之地 Guarded Land**

**增益：**你与大地精魂建立了联系。你获得⟦护佑之地 Guarded Land⟧威能。

⟦护佑之地 Guarded Land⟧

**11级：大地守卫行动 Land Guarding Action**

**增益：**当你花费行动点进行额外动作时，你可以移动由⟦护佑之地 Guarded Land⟧创造出的区域3格。此移动结束后，任何该区域内的敌人受到等同于你主属性调整值的伤害。

**11级：自然管理者 Nature's Steward**

**增益：**每日一次，你能进行⟦自然沟通 Speak with Nature⟧仪式而无需花费材料。此外，你不再需要吃喝。

**11级：大地斥责 Land's Rebuke**

**20级：觉醒之怒 Awakened Fury**

title: 大光明拳 Radiant Fist
body:
**大光明拳 Radiant Fist**
「大日正觉金刚力，降妖伏魔以神名。」

**前提条件：武僧，在宗教上受训**

You studied in a monastery devoted to the gods, guiding your mastery of psionic magic with the discipline and study of your faith. You likely worship Pelor or Bahamut, but most non-evil deities have at least one monastery dedicated to the fighting arts.

Your monk abilities are touched by divine power, allowing you to channel radiant energy and tap into the astral realm. Like other monks, you move with incredible speed and hit with unmatched power. In addition, the gods provide you with the ability to quash those who follow the gods of evil.

Dwarf monks are frequently drawn to this paragon path, since their piety and endurance allow them to withstand the mental and physical demands placed on a radiant fist.

**11级：花开见佛 Channel Divinity**

**增益：**你获得「引导神力」职业特性。这意味着每遭遇一次你可以使用一个引导神力威能。你同时获得你选择的一个神力专长。

**11级：明心见性 Radiant Fist's Action**

**增益：**当你花费一个行动点进行额外动作时，你恢复15点生命值。直到你下一回合结束，你的攻击造成等同于你感知调整值的额外光耀伤害。

**11级：如来神掌 Divine Sun**

⟦如来神掌 Divine Sun⟧

**12级：大光明盾 Undimmed Sun**

title: 胆大杂耍师 Daring Acrobat
body:
**胆大杂耍师 Daring Acrobat**
「Agile movement is as much offensive as it is defensive.」

**前提条件：游荡者，在杂技上受训**

Acrobatics is a widespread and popular talent. All people, from nobles to peasants, enjoy acrobatics shows, whether amid the finery of court or the debris of the street. A few venturesome religious rites, especially those that pay homage to Avandra or Kord, require the skill. Mastery of the body is part of numerous education philosophies, and acrobatics is unmatched in cultivating fitness and balance. Thieves and burglars use the skill to ply their trade. Training is easy to find and widely accepted. Some youngsters attain a level of mastery well before they reach adolescence.

Not to be underestimated is the value of such proficiency on the battlefield. A combatant who is adept at acrobatics can maneuver like no other. The adroit use of the skill opens up advantages that other warriors can't attain and allows the acrobat to avoid being pinned down. Movement becomes quicker and smoother as the acrobat uses the whole body as a tool, rather than just relying on the feet and the legs. It's obvious why some martial training includes instruction in acrobatics.

It's also clear that the adventurer has even more use for acrobatics than a warrior or a soldier does. Explorers routinely face perils that are best overcome with agility, poise, and a sense of one's body. More than one fortune seeker owes life and limb to his dedicated schooling in acrobatics.

To say that of you is a gross understatement, however. It doesn't matter if you came by your skill in a formal academy, from family tradition, or through the school of hard knocks. You have made acrobatics not only an art form, but also a martial style all your own.

You flabbergast friend and foe alike with your talent. Using it, you routinely accomplish tricks that seem beyond mortal capacity. With your flamboyant derring-do, you deliver terrible attacks and deftly capitalize on the smallest openings.

**前提条件：角斗士主题**

清晨，旭日东升，日光如洗般照亮乡间的小道，角斗场中早已人满为患，看客们粗鲁的相互推搡，只为在一天之中最早开幕的戏剧中抢到一个最好的位置。很快，六名战士窜至角斗场中央，他们旋转跳跃，骨制或石制的刀刃反射出凌冽寒光。霎时间，人群沸腾了，观众们欢呼雀跃，迎接着刀尖舞者们的盛大登场。

就在此时，角斗场对面的沉重大门被缓缓推开，刺耳的尖利声响划破了欢呼声。大地震颤，观众们逐渐安静。刀尖舞者们夸张的装作惊慌失措的样子，慌乱地向人群求助。关押着猛兽的铁门缓缓洞开，角质甲壳上装载着狰狞刀片的猛兽踱步而出。雷鸣般的咆哮中，猛兽冲锋了。刀尖舞者们骤然散开，眼花缭乱地翻身横移，在人群目不暇接中闪转腾挪，不知何时就让猛兽庞大的身躯上出现数十个涌血的可怖伤口。

作为刀尖舞者，你已经掌握了在如潮水般的攻势中华丽起舞的危险技巧。你的刀刃锋锐无匹，在决斗上上编织着致命的舞步，在敌人构筑的天罗地网中翻滚跳跃。你的技巧不断提升，逐渐超越了曾经教授你技艺的大师。在战斗时，你喜欢于绝境中反复横跳，戏耍一番你的敌人后再飘然离去。

**地狱守卫 Hell's Keeper**
没有什么比魔鬼的更不可信，承受更多的恐怖命运。我知道，真相就在我的血液里

**前提条件：提夫林，任意神术职业**

在黎明之战最为凄凉的时代，阿斯莫迪斯，就是这个大主教，杀死了他所侍奉的神祗。作为惩罚，众神将阿斯莫迪斯和他的追随者囚禁在九层地狱之中，就这样，魔鬼诞生了。难说是明智之举或是之中错误，众神释放了阿斯莫迪斯，因为众神认为在对抗一位邪恶存在——荒神时候，另一位邪恶的存在是必要的。现在，谁能说哪一位更为邪恶呢？特别是阿斯莫迪斯参与了对荒神的战斗并囚禁了他们

现在你应该明确了一件事。九重地狱本应是一座监狱。阿斯莫迪斯同他的魔鬼们应该被锁起来，让他们彼此折磨。或许，他们永远都不能获释

你希望魔鬼回到他们的地狱中去，同时你的神祗祝福你的愿望。你的任务是让巴托地狱重新成为地狱生物的祸根，而非避难所，而你所侍奉的神祗已经将完成任务的工具交付于你。在所有的魔鬼为自己罪恶的燃烧枷锁恐惧之前，你将永不休息。在最后一扇神圣之门怦然关闭之前，在最后一把魔法锁扣合之前，你也不能休息。地狱需要它的守卫

「No pact binds me to a single strategy.」

**前提条件：督军，「机智风采」职业特性**

Bael Turath's armies were warlike beyond mortal measure. Backed by the power of the Nine Hells, the leaders of the tiefling empire thought their forces could overcome any challenge. And in fact the legions of Bael Turath were often victorious, a testament to their officers as much as their supernatural might.

The most infamous of Bael Turath's generals was a tiefling known today as Malachi. As a lower-ranking officer in campaigns of conquest, Malachi proved to be a disciplined and innovative commander, renowned for being able to adapt to any situation. He watched and learned from his enemies, changed tactics at pivotal moments, and regularly used what he knew of his enemies against them. Malachi never knew defeat until he faced forces under the command of Dhuryan Flamebrow of Arkhosia.

Stories differ on what happened next. Some say Arkhosia's leaders put Malachi to death. Others claim that he retired alongside Dhuryan, whom he befriended. A few claim that Malachi now marshals the forces of the Nine Hells.

Whatever his fate, Malachi's brilliance is the root of a tradition of battlefield leadership that has spread across the world. A collection of writings from Bael Turath known as The Hellpath Tome supposedly preserves a portion of Malachi's own writings. You might have benefited from such education. Perhaps your leanings led you on a crafty path much like Malachi's. Whatever your background, you know how to conjure victory from situations most dire.

我没看见你的未来有什么希望

哪怕身体一块肌肉也没动，心神的眼睛也可以穿越时间和空间。思想意识的移动比鬼魂更自由。但对那些拥有灵能天赋的人们，灵思的飞越却非常危险

body:
**颠覆之刃 Anarch of Shyr**
「此刃历史之悠久远胜汝等整个文明，由我挥舞之时其力量亦是如此。」

**前提条件：剑法师，⟦攻击庇护 Aegis of Assault⟧**

你曾深入研习了夏尔的颠覆之刃，一个元素裔剑法师们所组成的修会在数千年前发展出的魔法剑技。该派的研习者们驾驭着元素混沌之力，以迅猛爆发的能量彻底的毁灭他们的敌人。

无数个世纪以来，颠覆者们守卫着诸元素裔国度，保护其不受龙族帝国所侵害；他们同时履行着监察夏尔领主们的责任，在那片土地的统治者转向暴政统治时挺身而出。而当颠覆者们迷失了他们的方向，转而热衷于无事生非、操纵朝政时，修会最终变得四分五裂；仅有少数依旧忠诚于修会那远古职责的大师们，仍保存着颠覆者之刃的教义。随着艾伯尔（Abeir）和托瑞尔（Toril）在魔法瘟疫期间的短暂结合，颠覆之刃的信徒们将这项远古的传统带到了费伦

在接下来的几十年里，夏尔的颠覆者之道在费伦各处缓慢地传播开来。专注于此学派之道的剑法师通常现身于阿卡诺（Akanul）、阿格拉隆德（Aglarond）、卡林珊（Calimshan）以及龙湾（Dragon Coast）。夏尔的颠覆者们不再是一个统一的社会，亦不再守护着夏尔——但一部分成员仍然信守着古老的传统

You are intimately familiar with the power that comes with controlling your enemy's emotions. Fear is a good start, but you go even further, pushing fear into madness. You have chosen to draw upon the power of the aberrant creature that brings madness by its mere presence: the gibbering mouther. Your warcry carries the sound of a thousand voices, all shouting different things. Those who hear you claw at their ears, your voice infecting their thoughts and filling their hearts with terror.

With this power comes a change. Your mind… is different, somehow. Through subtle manipulation and quick feints, you excel at isolating an opponent from a group. You use tactics like those of a wolf, focusing on your foe and drawing it away from any assistance. For you, combat is an art form. You choose your target with the same care that a sculptor chooses a block of marble.

You relish the point in battle when the plans of your enemies fall apart. In one-on-one combat, you fight on your terms. You are the razor that cuts out the heart of a group, leaving the rest of your foes in disrepair. You're a master at choosing the terrain you fight in and the opponent you fight against.

Even though you prefer to act on your own, you rely on your friends to confound enemies and split their focus. This strategy gives you the opportunity to move in and employ your skills. **锻造之魂 Soulforged**
「I have been tempered by the white flames of the Soulforge itself. I will not break!」

**前提条件：必须信仰摩拉丁并拥有⟦摩拉丁之决意 Moradin's Resolve⟧引导神力威能**

Millennia ago, when the dwarves fought for their freedom from the giants, a pair of champions arose. Twin brothers Gildur and Toris Irontop fought fiercely and bravely, crying out to Moradin with each victory. They seemed unstoppable . . . until they came up against Durandus, “the Iron King.” Their axes could not nick his stony hide, and their hammers cracked against him. In the end, Gildur fled into the mountains with his grievously wounded brother on his back, praying to Moradin for guidance.

That night, both brothers had a vision of when Moradin first forged the dwarves from iron, bedrock, and diamonds. Each gained understanding of the Soulforge's power; Toris used its white fire to strengthen his body and soul, and Gildur used it to forge a hammer that could smash through iron like glass. When they battled Durandus a second time, both of their weapons glowed white with the heat of the Forge, burning, cutting, and crushing Durandus until he was no more.

After their victory, the brothers gathered the most pious followers of Moradin and taught them what they had learned. These devotees formed the first generation of the Soulforged knighthood, which has spent thousands of years mastering the white fire, and using it to protect Moradin's followers.

title: 盾牌大师 Shield Adept
body:
**盾牌大师 Shield Adept**
「坚盾告诫我生存之道，利剑低语尔灭亡之路！」

**前提条件：战士**

被传颂的历史总是与盾牌联系在一起，盾牌是战士最优秀的伙伴、是荣耀的执行者、是坚固铠甲的缩影。坚固的盾牌弹开敌人的刀锋和箭矢、阻挡怪兽的毒液和巨龙的火焰。当你仗剑冲向敌阵之时，只有最值得信赖的伙伴才能保护你的侧翼，而对你来说，没有什么比保护这样的伙伴更重要。

从古至今，盾牌完美的诠释了什么叫做战术。在方阵兵团之中，普通的年轻士兵们一个挨着一个，每一个都需要同伴的盾牌保护。在冲锋陷阵之时，横冲直撞的盾牌迫使敌人退后，或者直接将它们撞倒在地。训练有素的盾牌手们将他们的盾牌组合在一起，犹如铜墙铁壁一般抵御着外来的攻击。据说这种战术最早是由矮人创造的，叫做“巨石战阵”。

Arkhosian的斗士贤哲Khomagar说过：“盾牌为战场之法律，其保护士兵，犹如君王之法律保护国家。” 在许多种族文明中，方阵兵团的战士们会因为在战斗中丢失盾牌而被剥夺荣誉，甚至受到更重的处罚，其原因乃是在于，个人的失误直接意味着整体的削弱。在战争结束之后，人们将阵亡的勇士们托在他们的盾牌之上带回家乡，并将它的盾牌与他一同埋葬。而在矮人部族之中，一面破损的盾牌往往是失败与堕落的象征。

盾牌对于战斗小队中的战士们尤为重要，因为他依靠盾牌来保护他有限的几位队友。对于那些明智的战士来说，盾牌甚至比武器更具威力。

你对于这些了如指掌。在你经历的数不清的战斗中，你掌握了使用盾牌和单手武器作战的技巧，你的技艺令那些轻视你盾牌的人付出沉重的代价。

**多才奥术师 Resourceful Magician**
「哦~来一点这个……再来点那个~」

**前提条件：诗人，任意其他奥术职业**

尽管不同使用奥术的职业使用奥术力量的方式完全不同，但他们利用的是同一种能量。通过研究其他奥术使用者的技巧，你渐渐发现了他们之间的共性。你不再将秘法师深奥的公式视为障碍，而是通过绕开这些复杂机制的方式，以另一个方式复制了他们的法术。相似的，虽然你没有血脉中的天赋，但你也用别的方式满足了术士们狂野法术对能量的巨大需求。你可以掷出火球，召集奥术仆役，从神秘的强大存在之处汲取力量——以诗人法术通过平常方式使用的超凡技艺。有了这些新的知识，便不再有什么东西超出你的能力范围。

作为一名多才奥术师，你操纵着奥术能量最基本的形态。你从多元化的研究中获取最大的益处，让你模仿几乎所有其他奥术职业的特性。此外，这些研究还让你更高效更明智的使用你的奥术力量，你不会浪费任何一次施法的机会。你可能享受不到术士那原始狂暴的破坏力，也没有秘法师精巧诡谲的奥术公式，但你确实的拥有比他们更广泛的魔法知识，在你最需要的时候为你带来各种帮助。

body:
**恶毒掠食者 Animus Predator**
「你现在可能没法理解，但接下来真的会很疼。」

**前提条件：萨满，⟦呼唤精魂伙伴 Call Spirit Companion⟧威能**

At the core of every creature lies the animating spirit that gives life or mobility, called the animus. The shaman sees the animus in the spirit world as one of the most fundamental forces required for life. Therefore, striking at or manipulating this spirit is akin to changing the very fiber of a creature's being, turning a huge advantage into the weakness that brings about your enemy's downfall.

A shaman who walks the path of the animus predator has a simple philosophy: When you see no weakness, create one. By manipulating the animus, you make your foes weak to your allies' attacks. You strip away resistances and immunities, leaving your target open to devastating blows. You give your companions the perfect weapon to bring true devastation to your enemies.

prerequisite: 恶魔后裔主题，或任何非善良阵营
body:
**恶魔联体 Demon-Bound**

**前提条件：恶魔后裔主题，或任何非善良阵营**

The darkness of the Abyss is a deep wound in the center of the Elemental Chaos,a bleak vortex that births the planes' myriad evils. Corruption flows out from this darkening pit to infect the land and creatures and twist them to evil. During your adventures, you encountered abyssal energy—perhaps when you slew a demon or after you explored a tainted site. The corruption changed you, infected you, and exposed you to horrid evil. Now it is all you can do to hold that evil at bay.

**11级：深渊行动 Abyssal Action**

title: 恶魔杀手 Demonslayer
body:
**恶魔杀手 Demonslayer**
「滚回深渊并告诉那些臭虫我的归来。让它们尽情做好准备并集结部队吧。我已经等不及将它们尽数抹去了！」

**前提条件：圣武士**

作为残忍和混乱的化身，恶魔本身就是对你信仰的亵渎，你试图利用一切机会去毁灭它们。你得到了特别的祝福，并掌握了对深渊居民来说等同于诅咒的战斗祷告。你的每一次攻击都能轻易刺穿它们邪恶的防护，仅仅是靠近你就能让那些恶魔感受到莫大的痛苦。你发誓，即使深渊中还有哪怕一只恶魔苟延残喘，你都不允许自己有片刻的休憩。

除了最黑暗和卑鄙的神祇之外，所有神都将恶魔视为宇宙的一大祸害，并敦促他们的追随者根除任何地方出现的来自恶魔的威胁。大多数组织良好的信徒们致力于执行那些铲除恶魔的指令，那些身涂圣油、通过了古老仪式的恶魔杀手正是出身于这些人之中。

title: 恶魔学者 Demonologist
body:
**恶魔学者 Demonologist**
「The power of the Abyss is mine to command. Demon, obey!」

**前提条件：任意奥术职业**

You have nothing to fear from things you control. It's the things you can't control that can ruin you. As a demonologist, you know this lesson well. When you look into the eye of the Abyss, you have no doubt in your mind that you can learn to master it—one demon at a time, if need be.

You have never shrunk from looking into shady places to serve your ambition. The longer you peer into darkness, the more certain you become that the secret to overwhelming power is hidden in the Abyss.

As a consequence of your studies, you have gained the attention of a minor demon—a filthy quasit. Discussions with this companion have expanded your mind to grim new possibilities. At the same time, the lessons have dissipated any reservations that perhaps you have gone too far. The more you learn from this quasit, the greater the power you control. Thus far, you have blithely ignored a nagging suspicion that somehow things might go terribly wrong.

**11级：恶魔行动 Demonic Action**

The power of the Abyss infuses you. When you push further than your normal limits, darkness swirls about you, helping you withstand enemy attacks.

**增益：**当你花费一个行动点时来进行额外动作时，选择强酸，寒冰，火焰，闪电或雷鸣。每个邻近你的生物受到5点所选类型的伤害，并且你对此类型获得10点抗力直到遭遇结束

**11级：恶魔伙伴 Demonic Companion**

You have bargained with the Abyss and called forth a minor demon called a quasit. This creature is bound to aid your work and to serve as your companion during your adventurers.

**恶魔伙伴 Demonic Companion**

Your demonic companion obeys your commands without hesitation as long as you are conscious and aware. Your bond allows you to communicate with the quasit, enabling you to work together toward mutual goals.

**增益：**你获得一个⟦夸塞魔伙伴 Quasit Companion⟧。此夸塞魔是你的盟友，但不是你盟友的。

你可以和此夸塞魔通过心灵感应沟通，只要它离你20格内。这样做不需要有视线以及效果线。

你的夸塞魔等级与你相同，并且它的生命值，防御和攻击都由你的等级决定，这些都记录在它的数据表上。

此夸塞魔共享你的回复力。当一个效果要求你的夸塞魔花费一个回复力时，这个回复力从你的回复力中扣除。当你使用你的回气时，你的夸塞魔也恢复等同于你回复力值的生命值。在一次短休息结束时，你的夸塞魔恢复它所有的生命值。

如果你死亡或你的夸塞魔的生命值降到0，则你的夸塞魔消失。你有两种方法召回你的夸塞魔：

✦次要动作：你花费一个次要动作并失去一个回复力。这样做会使你的夸塞魔出现在你的空间，且它生命值等同于你回复力值。

✦短休息或长休息：你在休息结束时失去一个回复力。这么做会使你的夸塞魔出现在你的空间，且它生命值全满。

**夸塞魔动作 Quasit Actions**

作为受你控制的生物，你的夸塞魔离你20格内时依托你的指令行动。你花费动作它才会行动，且它在一次遭遇中的先攻顺序和你是一样的

**标准动作：**要进行一个标准动作，你的夸塞魔需要你花费一个标准动作来命令它这样做。

**移动动作：**当你进行一个移动动作时，你的夸塞魔也可以进行一个移动动作。或者，你可以留在原地而以一个移动动作来命令你的夸塞魔进行一个移动动作。

**次要动作：**要进行一个次要动作，你的夸塞魔需要你花费一个次要动作来命令它这样做。

**自由动作：**你的夸塞魔可以进行自由动作，而不需要你花费动作来命令它。

**触发动作：**若你的夸塞魔的一个触发动作被触发，它只有在你花费同样类型的动作来命令它这样做时才能进行这个动作。例如，若一个邻近你的夸塞魔的敌人引发了它的借机攻击，则你必须花费一个借机动作来命令你的夸塞魔来进行此攻击。

**夸塞魔独立动作：**你的夸塞魔违背其意志来服务你。如果你处于不能对你的夸塞魔发出命令的情况，例如你失去意识，震慑，被支配或离你的夸塞魔超过20格远，则其在DM的控制下作为你的敌人一样行动。当你再次可以发出命令时，此夸塞魔再次听从你的控制。

一个夸塞魔独立行动时在它的回合内可以进行一个标准动作、一个移动动作和一个次要动作。它也可以进行借机动作和自由动作，但它不能进行即时动作。

**夸塞魔 Quasit**

The quasit is a hideous creature, standing no more than a few inches tall. Thin to the point of gauntness, it ambles about on spindly limbs. When it speaks, it does so in a raspy, whispering voice, which seems to echo all around you.

⟦夸塞魔伙伴 Quasit Companion⟧

**11级：恶魔财产 Demonic Possession**

You can draw forth demonic essence and use it against your foes. A creature affected by demonic possession grows pale. Shadows circle its eyes, and blasphemous runes appear on its flesh.

⟦恶魔财产 Demonic Possession⟧

**12级：丧志凝视 Unnerving Gaze**

You have peered into darkness so often that it has changed you. Foes who confront you see the Abyss reflected in your eyes.

⟦丧志凝视 Unnerving Gaze⟧

**16级：恶魔召唤 Demonic Summons**

The creatures you summon hail from the Abyss. If not demons, they share their characteristics.

**增益：**你的⟦夸塞魔伙伴 Quasit Companion⟧和任何你召唤的生物在伤害骰上获得+2威能加值。另外，这些生物获得对下列一种伤害类型的5点抗力（当生物出现时选择）：强酸，寒冰，火焰，闪电或雷鸣

**20级：恶魔部落 Demonic Hordes**

Darkness's hold on you is complete when you learn a spell that invites demons into the world. Demonic hordes tears reality so that the shadows of hordelings tumble free to rend your enemies.

⟦恶魔部落 Demonic Hordes⟧

**噩梦织造者 Nightmare Weaver**

You use power drawn from your pact to expose your enemies' doubts and fears, using these terrors as your weapons. You might visit retribution on those who serve evil and destruction, or you might be a ruthless killer, hunting down those who offend you. Regardless, you are a creature of nightmare—a thing of the shadows—and those who earn your ire can know only a terrifying end.

title: 法痕专家 Spellscarred Savant
prerequisite: 必须有至少一个法痕，⟦法疫学徒 <兼职法痕者> Student of the Plague <Multiclass Spellscarred>⟧兼职专长
body:
**法痕专家 Spellscarred Savant**
「我不是异类」

**前提条件：必须有至少一个法痕，⟦法疫学徒 <兼职法痕者> Student of the Plague <Multiclass Spellscarred>⟧兼职专长**

自从法疫袭击之后，托瑞尔的表面遍布着各种可憎之物。现在，世界为之感到困惑，因为法痕生物在其所到之处播洒着疯狂与恐惧。但是对于及少数优秀的生物而言，毁损其皮肉的法痕并非是一种诅咒，而是一种巨大的恩赐。你是这些少数人中的一个，一名法痕专家。你显露着自己的法痕，视其为一道力量的标记，而对于你的敌人则是一种可怕的警告。

你已经懂得如何利用自身法痕所赐予的黑暗礼物，懂得如何传导其所具有的毁灭力量。现在，你能够掌控法痕下所蕴藏的不稳定力量了。你所掌握的法痕使你可以驱使被称为咒火的原始魔法能量，从而在战场中以其热力医疗自己，或者鼓舞自身。随着自身力量提升，你可以如同驱使兵刃般驱使咒火的狂暴，例如通过降下那未经调和已趋疯狂的魔法本质来将敌人烧成灰烬。

**11级：法疫亲和 Plague Familiarity**

**增益：**你在对抗法疫和疫变生物或法痕者生物时，在所有防御和豁免骰上不再受到-2减值。相反，你在对抗它们时，在所有防御和豁免骰上获得+2加值

**11级：法疫掌握 Plague Mastery**

**增益：**此典范之道视为法痕者兼职的典范之道。在11级时，选择一个7级或更低的法痕者遭遇攻击威能

在12级时，你获得⟦咒火医疗 Spellfire Healing⟧威能

在20级时，选择一个19级或更低的法痕者每日攻击威能

⟦咒火医疗 Spellfire Healing⟧

**11级：咒火行动 Spellfire Action**

**增益：**当你花费一个行动点时，你可以恢复一个你已经使用过的法痕者遭遇威能，而不是进行额外动作

**16级：咒火掌握 Spellfire Mastery**

**增益：**以一个自由动作，你可以消耗一个法痕者遭遇威能，使其不产生效果来给予你自己或一个离你5格内的盟友恢复一个此遭遇中已使用过的奥术遭遇威能

title: 法卫法师 Spellguard Wizard
body:
**法卫法师 Spellguard Wizard**
「我们能够察觉银月的先辈英雄的消逝，但没有一人察觉其迷锁也已经消逝。」

**前提条件：法师**

银月的迷锁近乎于迷斯卓诺的。不像迷斯卓诺的魔法盾，银月的迷锁要弱的多而且经历了法术瘟疫后接近崩溃。城市的幸存和继续繁荣更多的归功法卫们的努力， 他们是银月的奥术守护者联盟。

银月法卫们夕惕若厉，追猎城中的风险隐患，抗击亡灵，阻截各种碌碌魔物不让他们到达心脏之地拉露亚城。法卫冒险组织的相当大多数范围都基于城市的限制，所以只是表现出来他们如同银月的有效代表。

所有的奥术英雄都受到各级法卫的欢迎。邪术师、剑法师、还有其他的卓越智士。但是作为一名法师，你的奥术威能是组织的心和魂，正如密斯拉时代，今时的法师们也是守护所爱城市的攻击性武器。护盾可能会破碎，但不会被遗忘， 遗迹迷锁残留的能量交于你们指挥，去面对银月之敌。

**11级：法卫行动 Spellguard Action**

**增益：**当你花费一个行动点来进行额外动作时，你可以将你的敏捷调整值加到在此额外动作中使用的任何近程爆发威能造成的伤害上。

你同时在对抗近战攻击的AC上获得+2加值，直到你下一回合开始

**11级：法卫训练 Spellguard Training**

**增益：**当你使用区域爆发威能时，你可以选择将其变成近程冲击。冲击的半径和爆发的半径相同。

当你以这种方式转换一个威能时，你同时在此威能的攻击骰上获得+1加值。

**11级：法卫力鞭 Spellguard Force Lash**

⟦法卫力鞭 Spellguard Force Lash⟧

⟦迷锁裂片 Mythal Splinter⟧

**增益：**你每天获得两个额外的回复力。

⟦迷锁火花 Mythal Spark⟧

title: 防护守卫 Ward Guardian
body:
**防护守卫 Ward Guardian**

**前提条件：剑法师**

从你最早的奥术训练开始，你就学会了用魔法保护自己——这就是你的剑法防卫，你如臂使指的奥术技巧。但与其他剑法师不同，你将此才能提升到了全新的水平。

你深入钻研了剑法防卫的各种秘密，并且认识到它比大多数剑法师想象的更灵活。你发现了改变和塑形剑法防卫的方法。精心研究后，你已可以将它变为保护盟友的可靠屏障，或是干扰打击敌人的危险武器。

**11级：守卫行动 Guardian's Action**

**11级：咒法之盾 Spellshield**

title: 放荡流氓 Rakish Swashbuckler
body:
**放荡流氓 Rakish Swashbuckler**
「长着一副那样的脸，难怪你妈最喜欢我了！」

**前提条件：游荡者**

Life is too short to take seriously. Danger lurks in every shadow, and an enemy waits behind every door. Those who spend every waking moment thinking about all the bad things that could happen never leave the house.

Instead of wringing your hands, you throw away all your worries and take a devil-may-care attitude. Sure, some say you will end up raking the coals of the Nine Hells because of your decadent living. In the end, though, who's the happier: you and your adventurous, libertine ways or the hidebound drudge shuddering under his covers?

On one hand, you're a charmer. Others find your infectious wit and bravado winsome. But you're also irreverent, irresponsible, and reckless. What's worst is that sometimes you have the hardest time keeping your mouth shut. Whether cracking a joke in the middle of a solemn funeral or shouting a barrage of insults at a demon, you can't help but stir up trouble. Deep down, you know life might be easier if you straightened up, but where's the fun in that?

When you face a serious challenge, your skill with weapons comes to the fore. Your tongue and your body language become secondary instruments of derision. You seed your exploits with cutting insults and disdain, goading your enemies into overextending or making other mistakes. When an enemy gives you an opening, you press the advantage. In the end, you stand triumphantly over a fallen foe, showing once again who the greater fool is.

title: 飞刀大师 Flying-Blade Adept
prerequisite: 游荡者，⟦即时备战 Quick Draw⟧专长
body:
**飞刀大师 Flying-Blade Adept**
「那些猴子还在辛苦的刺杀，可是现在飞刀才叫有个性。」

**前提条件：游荡者，⟦即时备战 Quick Draw⟧专长**

Among common folk, knife and shuriken throwing are forms of entertainment and sport. Competitors throw under calm conditions at stationary targets. At the extreme, carnival throwers toss blades at a moving mark, or sport throwers have to put up with rowdy onlookers and too much drink.

It takes a special breed of warrior to specialize in throwing blades in actual combat. The clash of steel, the rush of magical forces, and the screams of the wounded and dying are far more than taproom distractions. Moreover, the idea of tossing away a weapon seems tantamount to suicide. Still, anyone who has mastered the technique of hurling blades in battle knows that doing so helps to keep one out of harm's way.

Being such an expert takes guts, discernment, smarts, and quickness. The hurler must be brave enough to throw away a weapon, and to stand fast when the enemy recognizes the danger that he or she presents. The thrower's senses must be accurate enough to discern when to move and where. Furthermore, perception is nothing without the good judgment to exploit opportunities and to carry the right array of blades. And all this means little if the wielder lacks the agility orspeed to take advantage of whatever battle situation arises.

You are such an expert with light thrown blades. Swift enough to draw weapons in rapid succession and to knock an arrow out of the air, you have little to fear when you throw a blade. Your talent allows you to hit with terrifying accuracy, to bounce your blades off one target and into another, and even to punch holes in enemy armor. You have even been known to throw so quickly that you can hit every target in your field of vision.

body:
**飞天御剑 Soaring Blade**
「剑不仅仅是武器，它有剑灵。」

**前提条件：武僧，在杂技上受训**

战斗不是单纯的血肉横飞。这是一场表演，这是招架与击刺之圆，挥斩与还击之舞。剑之达者可以凌风而立，御剑而行，谓之善攻者动于九天之上。

融会贯通的精准剑舞让你俯视那些地面上的战斗者。苦修和灵能之力让你动若雷霆，以气为刃。

body:
**飞旋翅果 Whirling Samara**
「对你这掠夺者来说，这些种子意味着死亡。」

**前提条件：德鲁伊，「原力集群」职业特性**

As a druid who assumes swarm shapes, you have already mastered complex magic that maintains your identity even while you are dispersed in the form of many insects. Your new path focuses on gaining greater control of the individuals that compose your swarm forms. Most druids work with one swarm shape at a time, but you mix many different types of seeds, leaves, insects, and other natural things into a supremely flexible form, which adapts to any challenge.

Many of your powers take advantage of the whirling wings of the seeds called samaras or the buzzing wings of insects. You can take f light as smoothly as you shift into beast form, then send pieces of yourself whirling among your allies to protect them from harm.
